description: You are the grants administrator for the Department of Oncology at a research university. Dr. Sarah Chen submitted her NIH R01 grant application draft (/home/ga/Documents/r01_draft.docx) for your administrative review before the upcoming submission deadline. The NIH Program Officer has flagged a prior submission for format non-compliance with PA-23-093 requirements, and you must ensure this version passes format validation. NIH SF424 (R&R) format rules require: (1) all text in an approved typeface — Arial, Helvetica, Georgia, or Palatino Linotype — at 11 points or larger; (2) page margins of at least 0.5 inches on all four sides; (3) no more than 6 lines of text per vertical inch. Your department additionally requires: (a) a document header on every page reading exactly 'Chen, S. — R01CA298471 — Tumor Microenvironment Immunotherapy' aligned to the left; (b) every entry in the References section formatted with a 0.5-inch hanging indent (first line flush with the left margin, subsequent lines indented 0.5 inches); (c) the six major section headings — Abstract, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Innovation, Approach, and References — each formatted with a consistent 'Heading 1' style (not just manual bold). The reformatted document must be saved as a new file at /home/ga/Documents/r01_formatted.docx. Do not overwrite or modify the original r01_draft.docx.
